# Xaaalera’s Heroes V knowledge base / База знаний Xaaalera о Героях

> RU: Исследования Heroes V Universe, статьи и общие инструменты разработки модов. EN: Heroes V Universe research, articles and shared mod-development tools.

RU: Начни с нужной статьи и её области применимости. Draft не означает проверенную спецификацию; найденный адрес относится к указанной сборке. Для спорного вывода читай запись опыта и связанные данные. В отчёте различай чтение кода, изолированные тесты и новый запуск игры. Исходники ниже — Markdown без оформления сайта; ветка main может изменяться, поэтому записывай ревизию репозитория при проверке.

EN: Read the relevant article and its scope first. Draft is not a verified specification; native addresses belong to the stated build. Follow disputed claims to diary entries and evidence. Distinguish source inspection, isolated tests and a fresh game run in reports. Links below expose Markdown without the site layout; main can change, so record the repository revision used for verification.

## Start / Начать

- [Knowledge map / Карта знаний](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xaaalera/heroes5-knowledge/main/docs/reference/research-index.md): RU topic index.
- [Knowledge map in English](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xaaalera/heroes5-knowledge/main/docs/en/reference/research-index.md): EN topic index.
- [Research diary / Дневник](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xaaalera/heroes5-knowledge/main/docs/reference/research-diary.md): dated observations, corrections and evidence links, RU.
- [Research diary in English](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xaaalera/heroes5-knowledge/main/docs/en/reference/research-diary.md): EN experimental history.
- [Pinned build / Проверенная сборка](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xaaalera/heroes5-knowledge/main/docs/reference/universe-build.md): hashes and applicability; EN counterpart is linked in its metadata.

## Devkit / Стенд

- [Devkit agent instructions / Инструкции агенту](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xaaalera/heroes5-mod-devkit/main/AGENTS.md): bilingual reading order, checks and reporting rules.
- [Devkit setup / Развёртывание](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xaaalera/heroes5-mod-devkit/main/README.md): Windows requirements, workspace, sandbox and first mod, RU/EN.
- [Command reference / Команды](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xaaalera/heroes5-mod-devkit/main/docs/commands.md): build/control/capture/shutdown and their limits, RU/EN.
- [Environment overview / Устройство стенда](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xaaalera/heroes5-knowledge/main/docs/modding/devkit.md): RU article with links to source tools.
- [Environment overview in English](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xaaalera/heroes5-knowledge/main/docs/en/modding/devkit.md): EN article.

## Evidence / Данные

- [Placement observations](https://xaaalera.github.io/heroes5-knowledge/assets/placement/observations.json): recorded armies, blocked cells, contexts and image hashes.
- [Executable placement walkthrough](https://xaaalera.github.io/heroes5-knowledge/assets/placement/placement_walkthrough.py): scoped reconstruction, not the complete game algorithm.
- [Archive comparison CSV](https://xaaalera.github.io/heroes5-knowledge/assets/archive-diff.csv): metadata only; fields and download hash are described in the build article.
- [Test polygon H5M](https://xaaalera.github.io/heroes5-knowledge/assets/WorkshopPolygon.h5m): own map; requires an installed game. Installation and validation limits are in the test-map article.

## Editing / Правки

- [Knowledge repository AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xaaalera/heroes5-knowledge/main/AGENTS.md): bilingual authoring and verification entry point.
- [Article standard and review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xaaalera/heroes5-knowledge/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): scope, reproducibility, evidence, translations and independent pre-push review.
- [Site build and checks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Xaaalera/heroes5-knowledge/main/README.md): dependencies and validation commands, RU/EN.
